augment_clinging.description:
### Darkness
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: no resource cost
Create a sphere of supernatural Darkness centered anywhere within range.
The darkness radiates from a central point, spreads around corners, and cannot extend through walls.
A creature with Darkvision can see through this Darkness. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.
#### Contesting Light
If a Light-sphere effect is created inside your Darkness, the creator of the Light effect makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: Your Darkness is countered and the Light effect functions normally.Failed Check: The Light effect functions only as an ordinary light source and cannot illuminate your Darkness.
#### Persistent Darkness
Augment - 2 cultivation points (your Path resource): Your Darkness persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Darkness on your turn without spending an action.
augment_clinging.label: Augment Darkness: Clinging Darkness

modifier.description:
Augment - 0 CP: Center an area of Darkness on one creature or object rather than a stationary point.
If targeting a creature or its worn or held object, that creature may make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The Darkness is anchored to the creature or object and moves with it.
An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
modifier.name: Clinging Darkness
